name: 2400 W CRPS server power supply
summary: A hot-swap CRPS power supply for GPU and AI servers, with PMBus monitoring. Sample data: the supplier and every figure here are fictional.

buyers: Server assemblers building for Indian data centers
demand.reason: India's data center capacity is set to triple from 1.6 GW in mid-2026 to 6 GW by 2029, with over 50 billion US dollars committed by hyperscalers. Every server needs one or two power supplies, and GPU servers need several.

sources.title: JLL India data centre 2026 mid-year report

specs.label: Peak efficiency
specs.tolerance: at least the stated value at 50 percent load

specs.label: Hold-up time
specs.tolerance: at least the stated value at full load

parts.name: Chassis
parts.role: Hold the boards and slide into the server bay.
parts.whatItDoes: A folded steel tray that carries the boards, guides the unit into its bay and shields its noise.
parts.whyItMatters: Chassis fit decides whether the unit hot-swaps cleanly. Sharp or out-of-spec edges damage bays.
buyingChecks: Check outer dimensions against the CRPS form factor
Ask for the plating spec
Check the latch engages in your bay

parts.name: Main board
parts.role: Carry the power stages and control circuits.
parts.whatItDoes: A thick-copper board with the input filter, power factor correction stage, isolated converter and output rectifiers.
parts.whyItMatters: Layout and copper weight decide efficiency and how evenly heat spreads. Hot spots shorten capacitor life.
buyingChecks: Ask for the efficiency curve at 230 V input
Ask for the board maker and UL file number
Ask whether the board is conformal coated

parts.name: Transformer and inductors
parts.role: Isolate the output and smooth the current.
parts.whatItDoes: A high-frequency transformer gives safety isolation and steps the voltage down. Inductors filter the input and output currents.
parts.whyItMatters: Core material and winding decide losses at full load. The transformer is a safety part: its insulation keeps mains away from the server.
parts.material: Ferrite and powdered iron cores with copper windings
buyingChecks: Ask for the transformer's insulation class and creepage distances
Ask for the core material
Ask for the transformer maker

parts.name: Bulk capacitors
parts.role: Store energy so the server rides through short power dips.
parts.whatItDoes: Large high-voltage electrolytic capacitors after the power factor stage. They set the hold-up time.
parts.whyItMatters: Capacitors age with heat and are the most common wear-out part in a power supply. Origin and temperature rating matter.
buyingChecks: Ask for the capacitor maker and series
Ask for the temperature rating and rated life
Ask for the hold-up time at full load

parts.name: Power semiconductors and heatsinks
parts.role: Switch the power and shed the heat it makes.
parts.whatItDoes: Silicon carbide or gallium nitride switches and rectifiers clamped to finned aluminium heatsinks in the airflow.
parts.whyItMatters: These parts set peak efficiency. Their origin is the question buyers increasingly ask, since few countries make them.
parts.material: SiC or GaN devices on extruded aluminium
buyingChecks: Ask for the semiconductor maker and origin
Ask for heatsink temperature at full load
Ask whether thermal paste or pads are used

parts.name: Cooling fan
parts.whatItDoes: A 40 mm fan at the handle end, controlled by the supply's own firmware from load and temperature.
parts.whyItMatters: The fan is the moving part most likely to fail first. Its noise and power draw are part of the supply's spec.
parts.material: Plastic frame and impeller, ball bearings
buyingChecks: Ask for the fan's bearing type and rated life
Ask whether the fan is replaceable on its own
Ask for fan speed at 50 percent load

parts.name: Card-edge connector
parts.role: Carry power and signals into the server without cables.
parts.whatItDoes: Gold-plated fingers on the end of the board that plug into the server's power backplane.
parts.whyItMatters: Plating thickness decides how many insertions the connector survives and how hot it runs at full current.
buyingChecks: Ask for the gold plating thickness
Check the pinout and PMBus address against your server
Ask for the rated insertion cycles

parts.name: Top cover and handle
parts.role: Close the unit and give a handle for hot-swap.
parts.whatItDoes: A steel lid with vents, plus the handle and latch at the front.
parts.whyItMatters: Vent pattern shapes airflow. The latch decides whether the unit can be swapped safely with the server running.
parts.material: Zinc-plated sheet steel and plastic handle
buyingChecks: Check the label carries the VK code and serial number
Check the latch releases with one hand
Ask for the cover's earth bond test
